important_scope_limit: The file-reader preview exposes only a subset of the workbook's 1331 character records. No full-roster count, visual character recognition accuracy, or completed character-sheet validation is claimed.
evaluation_method: Each workbook character was reduced to a sorted set of explicit canonical tags, then grouped by exact equality for three feature selections. No model inference is used.
interpretation: Equal attribute signatures cannot reliably distinguish individual identities. Visual-reference embeddings, validated sheets and multi-subject isolation are necessary. Missing evidence must abstain and enter Review.
requirements: Never allocate new CH IDs from this dataset
Do not overwrite canonical data or user-corrected Fusion records
Count missing taxonomy families as unsupported, not recognized
Re-run on complete 1331-character workbook plus real-image independent holdout before release acceptance
